frequency_question: How often do substantive diplomatic understandings on transboundary water sharing successfully translate into formal, signed bilateral treaties or memoranda matching specific publication criteria before the expiration deadline?
membership_rule: Includes any bilateral river water sharing negotiations facing a hard expiration date of a prior treaty. Excludes multilateral river basins and informal unwritten understandings.
